description: This file implements a factory for encoding and decoding JSON values into and from CBOR format using the Jackson library. It supports reading CBOR data into internal JSON representations and creating CBOR byte arrays from JSON objects or arrays. It also features methods for creating CBOR representations from field maps and lists, indicating its role in serialization/deserialization within the project.

classes.name: JacksonCborFactory
classes.description: A final class implementing the CborFactory interface, providing methods for serializing and deserializing JSON values with CBOR via Jackson.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Returns true, indicating CBOR support is available.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads CBOR-encoded bytes into an internal JsonValue representation.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Serializes a JsonValue to a byte array in CBOR format.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates a CBOR byte array from a map of JSON fields, with an estimated size.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Creates a CBOR byte array from a list of JsonValue objects, with an estimated size.
